hook.en: I don't know. We're going to find out.

objective: Season finale. The full cipher is revealed: YOU ARE NOT LOST. YOU ARE BUILDING THE MAP. The Traveler looks back at every "life" from Episode 2 and understands they were the map all along. Moon shows many paths still unexplored.

captions.es: No estabas perdido. Estabas construyendo el mapa.
captions.en: You were never lost. You were building the map.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler and NØVA standing before the full Moon map, full cipher text glowing: YOU ARE NOT LOST. YOU ARE BUILDING THE MAP.

notes: Theme: reframing the entire season — dispersion (Ep02) was never a detour, it was the map being built.
Emotional conflict resolved (not eliminated): purpose found in retrospect, not as a fixed destination ahead.
Closing dialogue: NØVA — "¿Y ahora para dónde?" The Traveler, looking at the horizon — "No sé." (pause) "Vamos a descubrirlo."
Ending is deliberately open — Moon shows many unexplored paths, framed as aspiration, not a roadmap commitment (see TIMELINE.md row 10).
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 10.
